newsitem.title: FRANCE: Groupe Paribas ROE 12.1 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Groupe Paribas ROE 12.1 pct in 1996.

text.p: Groupe Paribas said on Thursday it had 1996 return on equity of 12.1 percent.

Paribas' estimated net asset value totalled 52.9 billion francs at the end of the financial year, a 3.4 percent increase over the level at the end of 1995. This rise is due to the increase in unrealised capital gains, the company said.

Consolidated net worth was stable at 40.3 billion francs as the cancellation of treasury shares -- held by Cie de Navigation Mixte -- from Groupe Paribas consolidated shareholder' equity and the distribution of dividends for 1995 were offset by the net income earned during the financial year.

Estimated net asset value per share amounts to 483 francs compared to 438 at the end of 1995, for an average number of shares outstanding of 109.4 million, down 7.5 million from a year ago, mainly due to the cancellation of treasury shares.
The tier one Cooke ratio at the end of 1996 rose to eight percent from 7.9 percent from a year ago and the total Cooke ratio was stable at 8.8 percent.
